law_text: Where the signal is a green turn arrow alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal may proceed only in the direction indicated by the arrow signal so long as the arrow is illuminated, but the traffic must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians lawfully within the adjacent crosswalk and to other traffic lawfully using the intersection.

topic_inventory.sole-turn-arrow: A green turn arrow alone governs only facing vehicular traffic and only while illuminated.
topic_inventory.direction: Facing traffic may proceed only in the direction indicated by the illuminated arrow.
topic_inventory.pedestrian-yield: Traffic must yield to pedestrians lawfully within the adjacent crosswalk.
topic_inventory.other-traffic-yield: Traffic must yield to other traffic lawfully using the intersection.
